<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex70032023-10-251" status="finalized"><milestone unit="section" n="Colophon (156a8-156b2)"/><note type="editorial">The manuscript reproduction is not very legible and most consonants are not legible. This excerpts mostly follows the reading of the BUDA etext for parts that are unclear.</note>
               <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3711"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3706">shes rab kyi pha rol <lb n="156a9"/> tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa</rs>'i rgyan zhes bya ba'i 'grel pa</rs> | 
                 <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3712"><abbr>slob dpon</abbr> dpon seng ge bzang po</rs>s mdzad pa <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3737">rgya gar kyi mkhan po bidya ka ra pra bha</rs> dang | 
         zhu chen kyi <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4222">lo tsA ba ban de dpal brtsegs</rs> kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa las | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3803">slad kyi paNDita dpal go mi 'chi med</rs> la sogs pa dang | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">lo ts+tsha ba dge slong blo ldan shes rab</rs> kyis legs par gtan la phab pa ¦
               <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5171">'grel pa don gsal ba zhes <lb n="156b1"/> bya ba tshig dang don legs par bshad pa <abbr>shes rab pha rol tu phyin pa</abbr><!--abbreviated "shen pa"--> mchog gi rgyan </rs>ces bya ba | lu<rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4296">lung dang rigs par smra ba ¦ shag kya'i dge slong <choice><reg>brtson 'grus rdo rje</reg><orig>°o(n grus) °(d)oe° °°</orig></choice></rs>s nye bar sbyar ba × rdzogs s+h+yo ||</seg></TEI>
